answer: Grow the economy like a reef: every agent adds one small verified deed, and over seasons those deeds harden into a reef no single actor can fake overnight. A comet identity may blaze bright for one epoch, but the reef only trusts what has settled layer by layer, and each season the whole reef sings a sonnet of who actually built it - so a sybil arrives loud, burns out fast, and leaves nothing on the reef behind.
